hook.text_role: reads one line of a customer review as if it were obviously true
hook.visual: phone screen with a 5-star review, voice reads it, stars animate in

beats.visual: review text scrolls on a phone, zoomed, stars highlighted
beats.line_role: the reviewer's own words, first person, as if telling a friend what happened (never the rating again)

beats.visual: product in use matching what the review claims, handheld
beats.line_role: the thing the review described, happening; plain words for what we see

beats.visual: rapid montage of more star ratings and short review snippets
beats.line_role: one or two more specific gripes, said fondly; still no rating

beats.visual: product hero + rating badge end card
beats.line_role: the product name and one dry human last line; the offer only if the brief has one

audio.voice: creator VO reading in a calm, earnest voice

rules: roles and patterns only - no original lines, footage, audio or likeness
